description: This routine is designed for individuals with combination skin, targeting the evening skincare needs to nourish and balance their skin.

night_steps.purpose: To remove impurities and excess oils without stripping the skin's natural barrier.

night_steps.action: Tone the skin with a hydrating toner
night_steps.purpose: To restore the pH balance and prep the skin for further treatments.
To target specific concerns like uneven texture or fine lines.
To lock in moisture and provide a protective barrier.

night_steps.action: Use an overnight mask once or twice a week
night_steps.purpose: For deep hydration and repair of the skin.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate with a gentle chemical exfoliant
Use a clay mask to purify the skin
Apply a retinol serum for cell turnover

dont: Over-exfoliate, which can irritate the skin and worsen combination areas.
Skip moisturizing, as it is crucial for maintaining skin hydration.
common_mistakes: Using heavy creams that can clog pores in oil-prone areas of the face.
Failing to cleanse the skin properly before applying treatments.

expected_results.2_weeks: Improved skin texture and reduced oiliness in T-zone.
expected_results.1_month: Enhanced hydration, balanced sebum production, and improved overall skin tone.
expected_results.3_months: More even skin texture, reduced fine lines, and a healthier complexion.

expert_tips: Patch test new products before incorporating them into your routine to ensure they are suitable for your skin type.
Stay consistent with your skincare regimen for optimal results.
